lines: The local stack uses governed compatibility layers instead of pretending cloud providers are locally
- MinIO is the explicit S3-compatible local emulation.
- RabbitMQ quorum queues are the explicit local broker emulation.
- Redis is the explicit local cache/resume emulation.
- Optional OTLP export remains disabled by default behind `feature.local.optional-otel`.
Live HMRC or production credentials never belong in compose or seed files.
proseSections.plainText: The local stack uses governed compatibility layers instead of pretending cloud providers are locally available: PostgreSQL remains PostgreSQL locally. MinIO is the explicit S3 compatible local emulation. RabbitMQ quorum queues are the explicit local broker emulation. Redis is the explicit local cache/resume emulation. Optional OTLP export remains disabled by default behind feature.local.optional otel. Live HMRC or production credentials never belong in compose or seed files.
